analyst_view.overall: Early view: Rizespor (11th) finally won at home on 8 November, 2-1 against Erzurumspor, and coach Recep Ucar hopes it starts a better run; they are without midfielder Can Bozdogan after ankle surgery. Kasimpasa (5th) have lost only once all season and will be in their second league game under Alfred Schreuder, after hosting Alanyaspor.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals and I lean slightly lower. Kasimpasa have drawn five of eleven and their games average about 2.5 goals, Rizespor's about 2.6, and a new coach usually starts by making his team harder to beat.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners with Rizespor taking more at home. That fits a home side that has to chase results, and I have nothing that moves it.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.3 cards. No suspensions or flashpoints are reported for either side, so I stay with the number until the referee is known.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.0 shots. I lean lower: Rizespor's 16.3 looks a lot for a side that has scored 13 in eleven, and a Kasimpasa team settling under Schreuder is more likely to keep the game tight than trade chances.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.0 shots on target. In line with my lower shots view I expect around eight, with Kasimpasa's Benedyczak and Hajradinovic the most likely to test the keeper.
